entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return this VeloBand Pulse. I've had it with this thing and I want my money back. What's my order number... it's VF-886-2155.
I can certainly look into that return for you. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault with the band or more of a preference?
There's nothing wrong with it, I just **changed my mind**, alright? It was a total **impulse buy** and I **don't use it**. I want to send it back for a full refund.
Okay, thank you for clarifying. I've pulled up your order, VF-886-2155. I see the VeloBand Pulse was delivered on December 15th, which was 18 days ago.
And? Eighteen days, a month, who cares? I want to return it.

I understand you've changed your mind, but for the VeloBand Pulse specifically, we have a strict 10-day return window. This is because after that point, the device's activation permanently links the hardware to a user's private account. Since it's been 18 days, I'm unable to process a return for a refund.

TEN DAYS?! ARE YOU KIDDING ME?! That's the most ridiculous policy I've ever heard! I want to speak to your manager right now! This is completely unacceptable, and I'll be posting reviews about this everywhere!

I absolutely understand your frustration, and I am the highest point of contact available on this call. My manager would have to provide the same information based on the policy for this electronic device. However, I do have an alternative solution that can help you get your money back.
Oh, here we go. A 10% off coupon for my next purchase? Don't bother.

Not at all. We know situations like this happen, so we created the official VeloFit **Resale** Marketplace. It's our dedicated platform for owners to sell their gear directly to other VeloFit users. For a new product like the Pulse that's in perfect condition, you can typically list it for very close to what you originally paid.
A **resale** site? So you're making me do the work to sell this thing you won't take back?

It's the best path we have to help you recoup your funds since a direct return isn't possible. It's secure, managed by us, and you set your own price. It's the perfect option for an **impulse buy** that you simply **don't use it**. I can email you a direct link and a guide on how to create a listing that sells quickly.
Ugh. Fine. Whatever. At least it's something. Send me the link. But if this is some complicated garbage, you'll be hearing from me again.

Of course. I am sending that email to you right now with the guide and a link to the VeloFit Resale Marketplace. I'm confident it will be a good solution for you. Was there anything else I could help with today?
Alright. Thank you again for calling VeloFit. Have a great day.
